Let Ω be any measurable space, μ any measure, and A,B bounded positive real-linear operators on L²(μ;ℝ). Assume A²=B², where multiplication is composition. Then A=B. No finite/probability measure, finite-dimensional L², nontriviality, energy identity or real/complex CFC/extension certificate is assumed.

blind_reconstruction.text: Let Omega be any measurable space and let mu be any measure on Omega. Let H=L^2(mu;R), the real Hilbert space of almost-everywhere equivalence classes of measurable square-integrable real functions. For any bounded continuous real-linear operators A,B:H->H, if A and B are positive (symmetric with nonnegative quadratic forms) and A composed with A equals B composed with B as operators, then A=B as operators.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2RealComplexOperator
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.StarOrder
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Instances
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Rpow.Basic

open MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2RealSquareRootUnique
noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem positive_square_roots_unique
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (A B : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ)
    (hA : A.IsPositive) (hB : B.IsPositive) (hSq : A*A=B*B) :
    A=B := by
  letI := IsStarNormal.instNonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus
    (A := Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
  letI : NonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℂ
      (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) IsStarNormal :=
    NonUnitalClosedEmbeddingContinuousFunctionalCalculus.toNonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus
  letI : NonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ
      (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) IsSelfAdjoint :=
    IsSelfAdjoint.instNonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus
      (A := Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
  let ι : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 μ := Complex.ofRealCLM.compLpL 2 μ
  let R : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ := Complex.reCLM.compLpL 2 μ
  let Q : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ := Complex.imCLM.compLpL 2 μ
  obtain ⟨hNorm,_,Ac,hAc,hAf,hAi,_⟩ :=
    L2RealComplexOperator.exists_positive_complex_lift μ A hA
  obtain ⟨_,_,Bc,hBc,hBf,hBi,_⟩ :=
    L2RealComplexOperator.exists_positive_complex_lift μ B hB
  have hReal (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) : A (A u) = B (B u) :=
    congrArg (fun D : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ => D u) hSq
  have hComplexSquare : Ac*Ac = Bc*Bc := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro g
    change Ac (Ac g) = Bc (Bc g)
    calc
      Ac (Ac g) = ι (A (A (R g))) + Complex.I • ι (A (A (Q g))) := by
        rw [hAf g, map_add, map_smul, hAi, hAi]
      _ = ι (B (B (R g))) + Complex.I • ι (B (B (Q g))) := by
        rw [hReal (R g),hReal (Q g)]
      _ = Bc (Bc g) := by rw [hBf g, map_add, map_smul, hBi, hBi]
  have hAcNonneg : 0 ≤ Ac := (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive Ac).mpr hAc
  have hBcNonneg : 0 ≤ Bc := (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive Bc).mpr hBc
  have hSame : Ac = Bc :=
    (CFC.sqrt_unique hComplexSquare hAcNonneg).symm.trans (CFC.sqrt_unique rfl hBcNonneg)
  let e : Lp ℝ 2 μ →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
    { toLinearMap := ι.toLinearMap
      norm_map' := hNorm }
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  apply e.injective
  change ι (A u) = ι (B u)
  rw [← hAi u, ← hBi u, hSame]

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2RealSquareRootUnique

steps.title: Lift both positive real operators canonically
steps.text: Use the compiled shared positive complex lift twice over the SAME arbitrary measure. The actual quotient maps ι,R,Q are identical in both results. The internally produced positive complex Ac,Bc satisfy Acι=ιA, Bcι=ιB and the literal coordinate formula for every complex L² class. The same theorem proves ‖ιu‖=‖u‖.
steps.formula: A_{\mathbb C},B_{\mathbb C}\ge0,\quad A_{\mathbb C}\iota=\iota A,\quad B_{\mathbb C}\iota=\iota B,\quad\|\iota u\|=\|u\|.

steps.title: Transport equality of squares
steps.text: Complex linearity and intertwining give Ac²g=ι(A²Rg)+iι(A²Qg), and the corresponding formula for Bc. The original equality A²=B² applies separately to Rg and Qg, giving Ac²=Bc² on every complex class. No multiplicativity or decomposition certificate is a public premise.
steps.formula: A_{\mathbb C}^2g=\iota A^2Rg+i\iota A^2Qg=\iota B^2Rg+i\iota B^2Qg=B_{\mathbb C}^2g.

steps.title: Apply complex positive-root uniqueness internally
steps.text: The fixed Mathlib complex operator algebra provides complex functional calculus and its restricted real selfadjoint instance internally. Both positive Ac and Bc equal the positive square root of their common square by CFC.sqrt_unique. Hence Ac=Bc. This requires no real functional-calculus instance on the original operator algebra.

steps.title: Recover equality of the real operators
steps.text: Norm preservation constructs a real-linear isometry e=ι, so ι is injective. Evaluate Ac=Bc on ιu; intertwining gives ιAu=ιBu, then injectivity gives Au=Bu for every real L² class. Extensionality proves A=B, including zero/subsingleton spaces.
steps.formula: \iota Au=A_{\mathbb C}\iota u=B_{\mathbb C}\iota u=\iota Bu\quad\Longrightarrow\quad A=B.
